definitions.paid: Job detail paidBy is a non-null 0x wallet (IMD docs: wallet that paid; null when nobody did). No separate on-job payment amount/x402 receipt is exposed on GET /jobs/:id — paidBy is the proxy.
definitions.non_oracle: Excludes template skill:oracle-assess (and skill:oracle*). List uses exclude=oracle.
definitions.swarmbrain_excluded: Legacy concentrated charts still exclude swarmbrain from the 'core' series; segment charts include those jobs under Team.
definitions.simd: Jobs with 'SIMD' in the objective are included in paid non-oracle totals and also counted in demand_simd_daily.
definitions.concentrated: Top 2 wallets by all-time paid non-oracle (ex-swarmbrain) count, plus any wallet with share ≥ 15%.
definitions.segments: Paid non-oracle jobs (including Swarmbrain) classified into team / team_adjacent / partner / unclear_bot / organic. Manual labels in wallet_labels.json win over auto funder rules.
definitions.labels_caveat: Segment labels are suspicions from on-chain forensics and cheap Blockscout funder checks — not proof of identity or intent.

segment_legend.title: Team / internal
segment_legend.blurb: Swarmbrain wallet or any job whose objective mentions SWARMBRAIN — treated as internal seeding, not retail demand.

segment_legend.title: Team-adjacent
segment_legend.blurb: Payers funded directly by surfsurf.eth, Adam, the IMD treasury (payTo), or the IMD token deployer — suspected ops/contractor spend.

segment_legend.title: Partner bots
segment_legend.blurb: Concentrated product pipelines (SIMD, Identity Units) plus wallets funded by the SIMD deployer or receiving IMDJobsPayer refunds.

segment_legend.title: Unclear heavy bot
segment_legend.blurb: Highly automated / bursty payers that don't cleanly map to a named partner (e.g. Pepeolithic/workflow). Kept separate on purpose.

segment_legend.title: Likely organic
segment_legend.blurb: Everyone else — best proxy for diversified / retail-ish demand. Labels are on-chain suspicions, not proof.

labeled_wallets.evidence: SIMD-tagged jobs; funded by SIMD deployer; IMDJobsPayer refunds.

labeled_wallets.evidence: IDENTITY UNITS create/review flood; public @IdentityUnits mint pipeline.

labeled_wallets.label: Pepeolithic / workflow bot
labeled_wallets.evidence: Bursty workflow/Pepeolithic jobs; gets IMDJobsPayer refunds — kept separate from partner.

labeled_wallets.evidence: 100% SWARMBRAIN trading-neuron objectives; internal multi-agent experiment.
